title: How many new items below the Approaching cut a regional assessment consortium must commission for each grade's adaptive pool when it moves its interim from one platform to another
subdomain: item-response-theory-test-equating (calibrating workshop items run on provisional ratings in an adaptive interim onto the launch scale)
prompt_shape: a count of items to commission for each of six grades; the conformed import file; per grade the imported items in each framework domain and the enemy sets with their items; a board memo with one chart

distractors.why_relevant: what the workshop paid per accepted item looks like the cost side of the commission
distractors.why_unused: the commission is a count of items, set by the floor and the pool

distractors.why_relevant: interrupted sessions look like a reason to drop or weight responses
distractors.why_unused: an interrupted session's re-delivery row is unscored and the scored row stands
distractors.ruled_out_by: the response file's own unscored re-delivery rows

distractors.why_relevant: each workshop item's ratings by the panel that set its provisional difficulty
distractors.why_unused: the panel's mean is already the bank's operational value, and the answer estimates the difficulty from the responses

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task488/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional regional assessment consortium of eleven Wisconsin school districts (Quarrystone Regional Assessment Consortium), a fictional delivery vendor (Tessaline Learning Systems) and a fictional new platform (Corvane Assessment); districts and students are invented and identified by code only.

files.covers: every item in Tessaline's bank for the consortium at close-out, with its operational difficulty and basis
every 2025-26 test event, grades 3 to 8, three windows
every item delivery in the 2025-26 test events
the consortium's authoring catalog, one row per authored version
the consortium's crosswalk from the 2010 standards to its 2026 framework domains
the writing panels' ratings of the 2024 and 2025 workshop items
the consortium's student roster for 2025-26 with Tessaline student keys
the consortium's note on the Quarrystone scale and cut scores
Corvane's item pool import specification, version 3.2
stipends and mileage paid to workshop writers, 2024 and 2025
